channel.title: Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: Guinea minister seeks balanced trade with Turkey
item.description: Minister Aboubacar Kourouma urged Turkish firms to invest in Guinea's production sector.

item.title: Guinea minister details electricity export revenue use
item.description: Mariama Ciré Sylla explained revenue from Kaléta and Souapiti dams goes to maintenance and regional energy sharing.

item.title: FRATEL meeting sets 2027 digital infrastructure priorities in Conakry
item.description: The 24th annual meeting of the French-speaking telecommunications regulators network concluded with plans to accelerate territorial coverage.

item.title: Guinea U-20 team returns home after winning UFOA-A tournament
item.description: The Syli U-20 squad arrives at Conakry airport at 19:45 on Monday, November 2, 2026.

item.title: Guinea army celebrates 68th anniversary
item.description: The military reaffirmed its loyalty to President Mamadi Doumbouya during the event in Koubia.
